            (function () {
                function normalizeAttributeValue(value) {
                    if (value === undefined || value === null) return undefined
                    var normalizedValue
                    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
                        normalizedValue = normalizedValue || value
                            .map(normalizeAttributeValue)
                            .filter(Boolean)
                            .join(', ')
                    }
                    normalizedValue = normalizedValue || value
                        .toString()
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .trim()
                        .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
                        .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
                        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                    if (normalizedValue === '') return undefined
                    return normalizedValue
                }

                    app_name: normalizeAttributeValue('Marketplace'),
                    app_env: normalizeAttributeValue('production'),

                    page_type: normalizeAttributeValue('item'),
                    page_location: window.location.href,
                    page_title: document.title,
                    page_referrer: document.referrer,
                    ga_param: normalizeAttributeValue(''),
                    event_attributes: null,
                    user_attributes: {
                        user_id: normalizeAttributeValue(''),
                        market_user_id: normalizeAttributeValue(''),
                    }
                }
                dataLayer.push(pageAttributes)
                dataLayer.push({
                    event: 'analytics_ready',

                        event_type: 'user',

                    }
                })

      <article>

        <h1>SHIOWLA - Link Situs Slot Online Resmi & Login Utama Situs Toto 4D Paling Terpercaya Tahun Ini</h1>

        <p>
          SHIOWLA merupakan link situs slot online resmi dan login utama situs Toto 4D yang paling terpercaya tahun ini. Nikmati akses stabil, permainan gacor, transaksi aman, serta layanan support responsif untuk pengalaman bermain yang nyaman dan menguntungkan setiap hari. Semua fitur disiapkan agar kamu bisa langsung fokus bermain tanpa hambatan.
        </p>

        <h2>Akses Resmi Slot Online yang Stabil</h2>

        <p>
          SHIOWLA menyediakan tautan resmi slot online yang selalu diperbarui agar tetap lancar diakses. <script>
const schema = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('faq-schema').textContent);
const faqContainer = document.getElementById('faq-list');
const reviewContainer = document.getElementById('review-list');

if(schema['@graph']){
  const faqData = schema['@graph'].find(x=>x['@type']==='FAQPage');
  const productData = schema['@graph'].find(x=>x['@type']==='Product');

  // Reveal animation sequence
  const reveal=(els)=>els.forEach((el,idx)=>setTimeout(()=>el.classList.add('show'),150*idx));
  reveal(document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item'));
  setTimeout(()=>reveal(document.querySelectorAll('.review-item')),600);
}

// Toggle FAQ
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(e.target.classList.contains('faq-question')){
    e.target.parentElement.classList.toggle('active');
  }
});
</script>

									<script>
  function updatePrice(type) {
    const priceEl = document.querySelector("#selected-price span");
    const labelReg = document.querySelector("#label-reguler");
    const labelVip = document.querySelector("#label-vip");
    const regulerItem = document.querySelector("[data-license='regular']");
    const vipItem = document.querySelector("[data-license='vip']");
    if (type === "vip") {
      // ubah harga
      priceEl.textContent = "100.000";
      // ubah label
      labelVip.textContent = "Aktif";
      labelVip.style.color = "#26A394";
      labelReg.textContent = "Pilih";
      labelReg.style.color = "#999";
      // efek visual aktif
      vipItem.style.background = "linear-gradient(90deg,#fff8dc,#fff)";
      vipItem.style.border = "1px solid #e80c0c";
      regulerItem.style.background = "#fff";
      regulerItem.style.border = "1px solid #f0f0f0";
    } else if (type === "reguler") {
      // ubah harga
      priceEl.textContent = "5.000";
      // ubah label
      labelReg.textContent = "Aktif";
      labelReg.style.color = "#26A394";
      labelVip.textContent = "Pilih";
      labelVip.style.color = "#999";
      // efek visual aktif
      regulerItem.style.background = "linear-gradient(90deg,#fff8dc,#fff)";
      regulerItem.style.border = "1px solid #e80c0c";
      vipItem.style.background = "#fff";
      vipItem.style.border = "1px solid #f0f0f0";
    }
  }
									</script>

<!-- JAVASCRIPT FOR DYNAMIC PREDICTIONS -->
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Data Pasaran Utama
  const pasaranList = [
    { id: "hk", name: "Hongkong Lotto" },
    { id: "mc", name: "Macau Pools" },
    { id: "sd", name: "Sydney Lotto" },
    { id: "kk", name: "Kingkong Pools" },
    { id: "sg", name: "Singapore Pools" }
  ];

  // Helper fungsi generate angka acak sesuai digit
  function generateRandomNumbers(digits) {
    let result = "";

    for (let i = 0; i < digits; i++) {
      result += Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
    }

    return result;
  }

  // Fungsi merender baris tabel
  function renderPredictions() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById("prediction-tbody");

    if (!tbody) return;

    tbody.innerHTML = "";

    pasaranList.forEach(function(pasaran, index) {
      const row = document.createElement("tr");

      // Styling striping tabel merah gelap dan merah terang
      row.style.background =
        index % 2 === 0 ? "#3a0000" : "#5c0000";

      row.style.borderBottom =
        "1px solid rgba(255, 209, 0, 0.32)";

      row.style.transition =
        "background 0.3s ease";

      // Isi Kolom
      row.innerHTML = `
        <td style="
          padding: 15px;
          color: #ffffff;
        ">
          ${pasaran.name}
        </td>

        <td
          id="4d-${pasaran.id}"
          style="
            padding: 15px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: #d49409;
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 209, 0, 0.55);
          "
        >
          ${generateRandomNumbers(4)}
        </td>

        <td
          id="3d-${pasaran.id}"
          style="
            padding: 15px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: #ffcc00;
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.48);
          "
        >
          ${generateRandomNumbers(3)}
        </td>

        <td
          id="2d-${pasaran.id}"
          style="
            padding: 15px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: #ff6b57;
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(217, 0, 0, 0.55);
          "
        >
          ${generateRandomNumbers(2)}
        </td>

        <td style="
          padding: 15px;
          text-align: center;
        ">
          <button
            class="rebake-btn"
            data-id="${pasaran.id}"
            style="
              background: linear-gradient(
                135deg,
                #d90000,
                #8b0000 55%,
                #ffcc00
              );
              color: #ffffff;
              border: 1px solid rgba(255, 241, 118, 0.72);
              padding: 6px 12px;
              font-size: 12px;
              font-weight: bold;
              border-radius: 4px;
              cursor: pointer;
              box-shadow:
                0 0 10px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.24),
                0 0 14px rgba(217, 0, 0, 0.24);
              transition:
                transform 0.2s ease,
                filter 0.2s ease,
                box-shadow 0.2s ease;
            "
          >
            Re-Bake
          </button>
        </td>
      `;

      tbody.appendChild(row);
    });

    // Pasang Event Listener ke tombol Re-Bake
    document.querySelectorAll(".rebake-btn").forEach(function(button) {
      button.addEventListener("click", function() {
        const id = this.getAttribute("data-id");
        const cell4d = document.getElementById(`4d-${id}`);
        const cell3d = document.getElementById(`3d-${id}`);
        const cell2d = document.getElementById(`2d-${id}`);

        if (cell4d && cell3d && cell2d) {
          // Efek animasi berkedip singkat saat di-generate ulang
          [cell4d, cell3d, cell2d].forEach(function(element) {
            element.style.opacity = "0.3";
          });

          setTimeout(function() {
            cell4d.innerText = generateRandomNumbers(4);
            cell3d.innerText = generateRandomNumbers(3);
            cell2d.innerText = generateRandomNumbers(2);

            [cell4d, cell3d, cell2d].forEach(function(element) {
              element.style.opacity = "1";
            });
          }, 200);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  // Jalankan render pertama kali saat page loaded
  renderPredictions();
});
</script>

    <script>
    (function(){
      const wrap = document.getElementById('snow');
      const COUNT = 45; 
      for(let i=0; i<COUNT; i++){
        const f = document.createElement('span');
        f.className = 'snowflake ' + (Math.random()<.2?'-lg':(Math.random()<.6?'-sm':''));
        const left = Math.random()*100;
        const delay = (Math.random()*-12).toFixed(2)+'s';
        const dur = (8 + Math.random()*10).toFixed(2)+'s';
        const sway = (4 + Math.random()*6).toFixed(2)+'s';
        const drift = (Math.random()*120 - 60).toFixed(1)+'px';
        const rot = (Math.random()*360).toFixed(0)+'deg';
        f.style.left = left+'vw';
        f.style.setProperty('--delay', delay);
        f.style.setProperty('--dur', dur);
        f.style.setProperty('--sway', sway);
        f.style.setProperty('--drift', drift);
        f.style.setProperty('--rot', rot);
        wrap.appendChild(f);
      }
    })();
    </script>


<script>
    function closePopup() {
        const popupOverlay = document.getElementById('popupOverlay');
        popupOverlay.style.opacity = '0';
        popupOverlay.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            popupOverlay.style.display = 'none';
        }, 300);
    }
    
    // Menutup popup ketika mengklik area di luar popup
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').addEventListener('click', function(event) {
        if (event.target === this) {
            closePopup();
        }
    });
</script>
